matchedTestNames: IPC authenticates two independent observers and passes the identical opaque session to callbacks
IPC refuses wrong control secret, panel secret and all identity pins without attaching
IPC rejects wrong role/domain, stale boot/challenge and extra authentication fields
IPC accepts chunked canonical frames including Unicode and rejects invalid framing before dispatch
IPC fail-closes request replay, reused id, wrong MAC/sequence/session, unknown method and extra fields
IPC clients verify challenge/ready role, identity, boot shape and MAC before exposing attachment
IPC clients reject forged replies, correlation mismatches and response replay without accepting invented result
IPC disconnect detaches once while the accepted callback drains exactly once
IPC client timeout never retries and the original accepted operation still completes
IPC enforces global pending capacity across detached sessions without cancelling their work
IPC bounds connections, authenticated sessions, inflight and per-session request history
IPC handshake/absolute session deadlines are bounded and do not infer authority from an idle socket
IPC private pre-send closure proof excludes forged errors, explicit close, cancellation and protocol failures
IPC submitted response loss never acquires pre-send proof after pending state is cleared
IPC preserves uncertainty for handler errors/invalid results and refuses non-JSON payloads before send
IPC reports unknown outcome after an effect followed by oversized result or throw and never replays on reconnect
IPC accepted callback failure marks every pending caller uncertain while other accepted work still drains
IPC onAttach must finish synchronously; detach faults are latched and close the transport
IPC cleans up a partially registered attachment exactly once when synchronous onAttach throws
IPC endpoint collision does not displace the original owner; concurrent close/listen leaves no listener
IPC server enforces its own inflight/history limits even against a client ignoring client-side limits
IPC correlates concurrent replies arriving in reverse order and rejects a captured request on another session
IPC client handshake timeout is bounded even when a local listener never sends a challenge
IPC absolute session expiry disconnects a pending caller without cancelling the accepted callback
IPC classifies only preconnect ENOENT and ECONNREFUSED as absence and sanitizes permission/unknown failures
IPC errors after a real socket connect and a handshake timeout never count as endpoint absence
IPC private AbortSignal cancels handshake and pending delivery without replay or callback cancellation
